builtinSkills.title: Built-in Hook Skill management
builtinSkills.description: Administrators can upload a Skill file directly. It is persisted as-is and added to the Hook Skill selector immediately. Uploading the same Skill name updates it.
builtinSkills.formatHint: No extension, size, frontmatter-field, or body validation is applied. The name comes from frontmatter.name when present, or from the file name. Administrators are responsible for correctness.

codeFlow.eventDescription: The event determines when Claude Code calls back and which parameters the extension receives.
codeFlow.matcherDescription: This text is compiled directly to the native Claude Code Matcher; empty or * matches all.
codeFlow.logicDescription: The template follows the selected event. Code receives Claude callback parameters and controlled CCUI APIs, then returns event-supported results.
codeFlow.apiDescription: Runtime injects these objects for the current user, tenant, and workspace; scripts cannot access paths outside that workspace.
codeFlow.runtimePending: This version stores the real runtime contract first. The script sandbox, file APIs, record API, and Claude callback executor will be implemented with the Hook runtime integration.
